headline: As of 2026-10-21: 14,729,137 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 43 of 50 states, D+16.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 14,729,137 early/mail ballots cast so far across 43 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,395,031), Texas (1,353,237).
